verdict.rationale: An official SmartBear MCP server is documented, and BugSnag's own changelog names a self-hosted MCP server with OAuth 2.0 browser login for connecting to BugSnag, so the product ships the capability directly. The evidence is only a probe pointer and a single changelog line, and it is SmartBear-wide and self-hosted, so the depth of BugSnag-specific coverage is unproven. missing for 10: documentation of the BugSnag tools/resources the MCP server exposes, agent setup/connection guide, any hosted (non-self-hosted) endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Self Hosted MCP Server OAuth 2.0 support — securely connect to BugSnag via browser-based login instead of manual API tokens.
